title: News Source Citing Patterns in AI Search Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Mapping cited news URLs in AI search responses to political leaning scores derived from audience sharing behaviors (DomainDemo dataset), categorizing sources as left-leaning, center, or right-leaning, and analyzing their statistical distribution and regression patterns across different models.

Measuring the concentration of news citations using the Gini index and log-odds ratios to evaluate the extent to which AI search systems disproportionately gatekeep by favoring a small number of prominent, high-quality news outlets while ignoring others.
